purpose: Apply the preregistered REG3+DYN joint-candidate opening rule and audit temperature-forcing fitness without fitting TN.
joint_candidate_rule: REG3_OBSERVATION and DYN_HYDRO_DELIVERY must both be spatially eligible in Stage47
temperature_rule: No all-reach aquatic Q10 unless a river-water temperature forcing covers the formal model period and scope
forbidden: fit a joint candidate when either component is spatially ineligible
use ERA5-Land lake mixed-layer temperature as all-reach river-water temperature
